_comment: Live market data for the Forward OS / Forward Motion Freight portal. Feeds the dashboard Market Pulse card and the Rate Calculator's suggested-rate button. SCHEMA MUST MATCH the portal reader's BUILTIN_MARKET shape in app/src/App.jsx (mergeMarketData): asOf, blurb, dieselPerGal, spotAllIn, trend(up|down|flat), modality[{type,rpm,yoy}], lanes[{lane,rpm}], commodityRates{}. Missing/malformed fields fall back to builtin per-field. Maintained by Dex (market desk agent) — see _sourcing for what's live vs carried-forward. Deploys to forwardmotionfreight.com/market.json via GitHub Pages.
blurb: Diesel's down a third straight week — $6.179, off only 2 cents, so the slide is flattening out. Spot rates gave back 2-4 cents, but that's fuel pass-through, not freight going soft: reprice your surcharge off the index, hold your base linehaul, and don't discount reefer or Northwest apples — they're still running way over last year.

_sourcing.status: SEVENTEENTH straight cycle with direct egress blocked (WebFetch www.eia.gov, www.ajot.com, www.logisticsmgmt.com = getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND; curl eia.gov and dat.com = CONNECT tunnel 403). WebSearch only. This cycle WebSearch delivered more than usual: EIA diesel week of 10/12 and DAT national week 42 (10/10-16). asOf advanced 2026-10-05 -> 2026-10-16 on the strength of the DAT week-42 all-in readings (modality + mapped commodity rates) and EIA 10/12 diesel. spotAllIn, lanes, LTL, Intermodal, High-Value Electronics are still older/carried (see per-field notes). EIA week of 10/19 NOT found (next release scheduled 10/20; not indexed yet).
_sourcing.dieselPerGal: LIVE (medium-high confidence, secondary sources). $6.179/gal for EIA week ending 2026-10-12, down $0.020 from $6.199 (10/5) - THIRD straight weekly decline (Logistics Management headline 'National diesel average, for the week of October 12, falls for third straight week, reports EIA'; also corroborated by a DOE fuel-surcharge matrix listing $6.179 for pricing date 10/12/2026 = 40.0% LTL / $0.79 per mile TL, and DAT Trendlines showing diesel $6.18 'decreasing'). Series: $6.529 record (9/21) -> $6.382 (9/28) -> $6.199 (10/5) -> $6.179 (10/12). Decline is DECELERATING (-18c, then -2c). No primary EIA read (egress blocked). EIA week of 10/19 not found. NOT USED: AAA/GasBuddy retail, FreightWaves DTS truck-stop index ($6.39-$6.57, a different index), all ~$3-4 stale-year items.
_sourcing.trend: DOWN - third straight EIA decline (10/12: -2c) and DAT all-in rates all down 2-4c w/w for week 10/10-16. Caveat: the move is fuel-driven (lower diesel accounted for nearly all of the DAT all-in decline), and the slope is flattening - if the 10/19 print (published ~10/20) is flat or up, flip to 'flat' next cycle.
_sourcing.spotAllIn: CARRIED FORWARD, NOT re-verified (stale, ~10/3). $3.53/mi, FreightWaves SONAR NTI (dry van incl. fuel) per FreightWaves 'Truckload's mixed signals' (published ~10/3-4). Re-searched this cycle: no newer NTI reading surfaced (NTI daily is SONAR-subscription only). Likely a bit lower now given diesel -20c since, but not adjusted without a source. Low-medium confidence; note it is a different index than the DAT per-equipment numbers below.
_sourcing.modality: Dry Van / Reefer / Flatbed REPRICED LIVE (medium confidence): DAT all-in (incl. fuel) national, week 42 = Oct 10-16 2026, via AJOT repost of the DAT release (read through a search summary; AJOT page itself not fetchable): Dry Van $3.09 (-3c w/w), Reefer $3.66 (-2c w/w), Flatbed $3.64 (-4c w/w). Reconciles with the prior week 10/4-10 reading in the same sources (van $3.12, reefer $3.68, flatbed $3.68), so the w/w deltas check out. DAT Trendlines month-to-date snapshot (van $3.06, reefer $3.61, flatbed $3.62) is partial-period and NOT used. Prior carried values were van $3.01 / reefer $3.63 / flatbed $3.60 (week 9/20-26). yoy updated from the same source: DAT linehaul y/y van +35%, reefer +33%, flatbed +29%. REEFER HAS NOT ROLLED OVER: $3.66 is down only 2c from a $3.68 peak and still ABOVE the $3.63 previously carried; the w/w dip is fuel pass-through. Separate reefer signals: 35-day DAT forecast reefer linehaul ~$2.69-2.75 late Oct (linehaul, ex-fuel); DAT produce report (week ending 10/13) total refrigerated produce volume -9% w/w, -4% y/y. LTL (+12.5% GRI) and Intermodal ($1.39, -5%) CARRIED FORWARD, no new data.
_sourcing.commodityRates: Re-synced to the modality reprice: General Dry Freight 3.09 (dry van), Frozen Seafood/Poultry 3.66 and Fresh Produce 3.66 (reefer), Coiled Steel 3.64 (flatbed). High-Value Electronics 2.60 carried forward, no data. NOTE: the app's FALLBACK_MARKET_RATES are older (2.47/3.20/3.20/3.57/2.60); only this live JSON overrides them.
_sourcing.lanes: Yakima, WA -> Northeast (reefer): CARRIED FORWARD from USDA week ended 9/29 (Boston midpoint $12,650, New York $12,600 via IndexBox/agtransport.usda.gov) - now 3 weeks stale. Re-tried this cycle: the USDA 10/7 and 9/30 FVWTRK PDFs exist (barchart s3 mirror) but search snippets only expose partial text (9/30 New York 9900-10400 and 9/23 New York 10100-10600 appear in snippets with unconfirmed origin - likely a different origin, NOT used); Yakima-to-Boston/NY $/load for 10/6 or 10/13 NOT retrieved. Directional only: DAT produce report (week ending 10/13, USDA data) has Washington apple/pear lanes ~72% above last year, rates 'held flat'; DAT blog items put Yakima->Miami ~$12.5k-13.5k and eastern metros up to $13k-14.8k (undated, ~late Sept) - conflicts with the 9/29 USDA Boston/NY midpoints, so the 9/29 numbers are kept and nothing is promoted. Atlanta -> Miami: CARRIED FORWARD, unchanged, 17 cycles - only undated marketing-site ranges (Numeo reefer $2.40-3.00, van $2.00-2.50; Freight Sidekick ~$2.13 van reverse direction) surfaced, no clean dated absolute $/mi; NOT promoted. Memphis -> Atlanta: not searched, unchanged.
_sourcing.blurb: Rewritten around the third straight diesel decline ($6.179 for 10/12, only -2c so flattening), DAT all-in down 2-4c as fuel pass-through, hold base linehaul, reefer not softening on the all-in and Washington tree fruit still ~72% over last year.
_sourcing.directionalCaveatUnverified: (1) Diesel $6.179 (10/12) and DAT week-42 numbers rest on secondary/search-summary reads, no primary EIA/DAT page. (2) EIA week of 10/19 not found - check next cycle; trend may flip to flat. (3) spotAllIn $3.53 is ~10/3 and unrefreshed. (4) Yakima lane is the 9/29 USDA reading, 3 weeks stale. (5) Atlanta->Miami needs a clean dated absolute $/mi. (6) asOf 10/16 reflects the DAT modality week; diesel is 10/12.
